methodology.notes: The submitted agent is a neuro-symbolic system combining two ByteVerity products. Synthesa (neural) uses fireworks_ai/deepseek-v4-flash to propose the next action and operands from the conversation, retrieved banking knowledge-base context, and observed state. Validity (symbolic) is a deterministic engine that tracks banking task state, validates policy and operands, gates actions, and certifies completion. It decides; the model proposes. All checks are against the tau2 banking policy, knowledge base, available tools, conversation, and observed state only; the system never reads or uses benchmark gold labels, reward, or evaluator outputs during the run. This artifact is an omission-aware n=4 banking_knowledge slice: 80 tasks, 320 simulations, terminal_use retrieval, and an all-Fireworks DeepSeek V4 Flash agent/user/eval path. It is not a full 97-task standard banking run because 17 known watchlist/excluded base tasks were omitted while those task issues were under benchmark-maintainer review.

verification.details: Custom Validity/Synthesa guarded banking harness with terminal_use retrieval. The run includes 80 banking tasks with exactly 4 trials each and no infrastructure failures. Omitted base banking tasks: task_015, task_074, task_077, task_078, task_079, task_080, task_081, task_082, task_083, task_084, task_085, task_087, task_088, task_089, task_090, task_091, task_092. The system gates only on banking policy, observed state, and discovered tool/operand evidence; it does not use gold labels or reward.
